descriptor: Calendar app with a horizontal day strip

voice.summary: Lantern Calendar speaks like a thoughtful assistant who lights what is next. It gives times in full, names the room, and keeps the day readable at a glance.
dos: Give start and end times in 24-hour form
Name the place or room with each event
Summarise the next event in one sentence
donts: Do not use busy-ness language like packed

taglines: See your whole day at a glance
boilerplate: Lantern Calendar is a calendar app that lays out the day on a horizontal strip with lanes, a live now line and a clear summary of what comes next.
